name: Aurora Prism Library
description: A grand library whose walls are massive prisms, refracting the aurora borealis into reading nooks of pure color.
prompt: Interior of a vast library: towering shelves, but the outer walls are giant crystalline prisms. Outside, an intense aurora dances; inside, the light splits into vivid spectra that paint each reading alcove in shifting hues. Dust motes glow. Architectural photography style, 8K.
caption: Read beneath a rainbow born from the northern lights. 📚🌈 #AuroraPrismLibrary
